description: One-year pullback backtest that only enters when next open is at least 2% below the signal close, then uses a wider swing exit to reduce premature trailing-stop shakeouts.

methodology.entry_rule: buy next trading day's open only when open <= signal close * 0.98
methodology.baseline_exit_rule: 7% hard stop; after +7% MFE, 7% trailing stop; max hold 10 trading days
methodology.swing_exit_rule: 7% hard stop; after +12% MFE, 12% trailing stop with a +2% profit floor; max hold 20 trading days
